summary: Completed Phases 1-5 of 7. Fixed load_fidelity_map() key derivation at all 4 sites in literature-search.sh (restores default-search visibility for Wijesekera/Simpson). Added --legacy-schema classify+write mode to literature-fidelity-audit.sh; stamped verified_conversion on 4 recoverable Group B docs and unadjudicated on arisakadasstrassburger_2015 (honest quarantined outcome). Phase 7 gate: disposition of the 10 unrecoverable docs is an explicit USER DECISION between option (b) per-doc adjudication to unverified_no_baseline, option (c) a new non-quarantined fidelity value, and option (d) leave as-is. The implementer did not choose. Gates phase 7 only; phases 1-5 are complete.
